policy.rendering: React; native SVG, CSS and Web Animations API
policy.motionPreference: Most restrictive of motion scope, glass provider, device reduced motion and forced colours.
policy.idle: Finite responses; no perpetual ambient loop.
policy.selection: Choose by intent and target; skip motion when there is no meaningful state change.
policy.sourceReuse: Original implementation of documented behavior; no third-party component code, artwork or .riv files bundled.
policy.parity: Coverage of selected interaction patterns, not full engine or catalogue parity with source libraries.
policy.durationMeaning: Nominal base milliseconds before timing presets and bounded part staggering; exact animation timing is owned by the component. Existing SDK entries use their documented kit timings.
